messages:
alex: quick sync — ran a perf sweep for KV-cache + remat interaction on TP=2 PP=4, noticed an all-reduce tail latency spike when remat is enabled.

maria: can you paste the profiler snippet? is this reproducible on local rig or only infra run?

alex: reproduced on dev-node (4xA100). here are the summary numbers (seq=1024, microb=4 -> global batch 16):
```
baseline (no-remat): allreduce mean 11.2ms, tail 18.5ms
remat-global: allreduce mean 13.5ms, tail 49.3ms
remat-selective: allreduce mean 12.9ms, tail 32.8ms
KV-cache hits enabled -> slightly higher scatter in tail.
```

jian: my hunch — recompute changes compute phase distribution across PP stages, which breaks comm/compute overlap. some ranks end up doing recompute right when allreduce starts, increasing wait.

sophie: also noticed batching heuristic interaction: when microbatching merges less aggressively (max_merge_tokens lowered), frequency of allreduces rises -> more tail susceptibility.

maria: any logs on nvlink/allreduce counters? could be head-of-line from imbalanced schedule.

alex: dumped NCCL timeline and KV cache traces. snippet: 
```
[#0] rank0 compute 120ms -> ncclAllReduce start 5ms -> wait 45ms
[#1] rank1 compute 80ms -> ncclAllReduce start 60ms -> wait 10ms
```
shows rank0 recompute pushed it into earlier window and it waits for slow peer.

perf-bot: perf dashboard updated: https://perf.internal/runs/1815001234 — artifacts + flamegraphs uploaded :white_check_mark:

jian: possible mitigations:
- shift remat to FWD-only / selective remat for large FFN to balance compute timing
- enable async_allreduce (overlap more aggressively)
- increase gradient_accum_steps to reduce allreduce frequency

sophie: another angle — KV cache placement. if KV cache fetches are interleaving with recompute (shared mem/channel), that adds jitter. For TP shards we could try local KV shards to reduce cross-rank RPCs during recompute.

maria: let's try a controlled sweep:
1) remat=off (baseline)
2) remat=selective (ffn-only)
3) remat=full
And for each: batcher.max_merge_tokens in {32, 64, 128}, async_allreduce on/off, kv_shard=local/global.

alex: sounds good. I'll spin up jobs. command I used for seed run: 
```bash
./run_perf --model=redwood-xl-3b --tp=2 --pp=4 --seq=1024 --microb=4 --remat=selective --batcher.max_merge_tokens=32 --async_allreduce=false --kv_shard=global
```

jian: add `--recompute_schedules=staggered` option to test staggered recompute alignment (tries to shift recompute windows to avoid allreduce overlap).

sophie: if staggered improves, we should consider scheduler tweak in batcher to intentionally offset recompute phases across PP stages. could be low-cost fix vs changing user remat policies.

alex: assigned:
- me: run sweep w/ and w/o staggered, collect nccl timelines (ETA 4h)
- jian: prototype staggered recompute toggle in runtime (small patch)
- maria: update perf dashboard to include per-rank recompute markers

maria: noted. I'll also flag to infra that KV RPCs might be contending with NCCL on NIC — ask for NIC QoS test.

alex: thanks. If anyone sees a quick win (async_allreduce or bump acc_steps) that gives a signal, post here and I'll prioritize. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: job 1815001249 queued, estimated 3.8h -> status will be posted here when finished.

sophie: quick note — keep an eye on generation latency percentiles, not just mean token time. tail impacts UX.

alex: agreed. will include p50/p90/p99 in the dashboard. closing loop once sweep done. :rocket:
